Rafael Costa is a Senior Data Scientist at NexaTech Solutions, specializing in enterprise AI solutions. With eight years of experience, he has developed expertise in scalable data systems and machine learning deployment within complex business environments.  

A results-oriented professional, Rafael leverages Apache Airflow to orchestrate end-to-end data pipelines, reducing ETL processing time by 40% in a global logistics project. His work with Apache Spark has enabled real-time analytics for customer segmentation, driving a 25% improvement in marketing ROI. In data warehousing, he architected a cloud-native solution that supported 10x faster query performance for a financial services client. MLOps expertise has been central to deploying models in production, with a focus on reproducibility and scalability across teams.  

Rafael’s technical foundation in Python underpins both system architecture and team mentorship, fostering cross-functional collaboration. He has pioneered time series analysis frameworks for predictive maintenance, reducing unplanned downtime by 30% in industrial clients. His use of scikit-learn has optimized anomaly detection systems, with measurable impact on operational efficiency.  

BSc in Computer Science, Federal University of Rio de Janeiro  
Senior Data Scientist – Enterprise AI Solutions, NexaTech Solutions (2016–present)
